claims.claimText: Red Rocks Amphitheatre directs end-of-event passenger pickup for private vehicles, taxis, and Uber/Lyft to the Jurassic Lot just inside Entrance 2 off Highway 93, recommending the downhill walk via Will Call Trail across from the Trading Post and down Red Rocks Park Road.
claims.authorityName: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre — Getting Here
claims.limitationsNote: Event-night traffic control staff and temporary lot closures control on site; accessible shuttles use separate designated pickup points.

claims.claimText: Red Rocks event parking lots open 2 hours before event door time; limo and shuttle bus drop-off uses the Top Circle Lot (or Upper North Lot at traffic-control discretion), and unoccupied vehicles left past 10 a.m. the following day may be ticketed or towed.
claims.authorityName: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre — Getting Here
claims.limitationsNote: Overnight camping in vehicles is prohibited, and overflow parking may be routed to the Jurassic Lot depending on arrival time.

claims.claimText: Red Rocks prohibits multi-pocket bags inside the amphitheatre; permitted bags include single-pocket or clear bags up to 13" x 15" x 8", small purses or fanny packs 6" x 9" or smaller, emptied hydration packs up to 2L (at most one extra pocket), six-pack soft coolers up to 10" x 7" x 7", and food in 1-gallon clear plastic bags, and items must fit under the 18" x 12" seat space.
claims.authorityName: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre — Permitted & Prohibited Items
claims.limitationsNote: Individual shows may impose stricter camera, beverage-lid, or bag rules at the gates; glass, aluminum cans, umbrellas, and hard coolers are prohibited inside the venue.

claims.claimText: Red Rocks confines tailgating to the rear of your vehicle without blocking adjacent spaces, prohibits glass containers parkwide as well as tents, canopies, amplified sound, portable generators, open-flame fires, and charcoal grills, and allows small propane grills (at least 12" off the ground, flame 6" or under) only when no temporary fire ban is in effect.
claims.authorityName: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre — Official FAQ
claims.limitationsNote: Full-strength beer and wine in non-glass containers are allowed in parking lots subject to Colorado law, while beer kegs, hard liquor, vending, and bringing outside alcohol through the amphitheatre gates are prohibited.

claims.claimText: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre publishes official concert, film, and fitness event dates and door times on its Event Calendar.
claims.authorityName: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre — Event Calendar
claims.limitationsNote: Show dates, support acts, and door times can change; confirm ticketed event times on the official calendar or AXS listing before show day.
